name: Uriel
title: Levite from the clan of Kohath
summary: Uriel was a Levite from the family of Kohath mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was among the Levites whom King David appointed to carry the Lord's ark of the covenant up to Jerusalem. He is also mentioned as the grandfather of King Rehoboam through his daughter Maacah (also called Michal), who was the mother of Abijah.

keyEvents.title: Levite from the family of Kohath
keyEvents.description: Uriel is mentioned as a prominent Levite from the clan of Kohath, one of the important Levitical families responsible for service in the sanctuary.

keyEvents.title: Appointed to carry the ark of the covenant
keyEvents.description: King David commanded the leaders of the Levites, including Uriel as leader of 120 descendants of Kohath, to consecrate themselves and carry the Lord's ark of the covenant up to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Transfer of the Ark to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Uriel and the other Levites carried God's ark as Moses had commanded, with carrying poles on their shoulders, amid great rejoicing and celebration.

keyEvents.title: Father of Maacah, Rehoboam's wife
keyEvents.description: Uriel from Gibeah is mentioned as the father of Maacah, who became King Rehoboam's wife and mother of King Abijah of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Levitical Service under David
keyEvents.description: Uriel was among the leading Levites whom David organized for worship and music in connection with the ark and the future temple.
